headline: Indian Markets Mixed: Nifty Gains While Sensex Dips Amid IT Weakness
why: Weakness in IT sector and Tata group stocks weighing on Sensex
Global triggers including US Fed decisions and rising oil prices
Concerns over UPI Merchant Discount Rate impacting retail trade sentiment
Ongoing market correction leading to sixth straight week of declines
whatHappening: Nifty 50 and Sensex show mixed performance in early trade sessions
Ashish Kacholia portfolio sees significant gains with four multibaggers in CY26
Accenture and Anthropic commit $2 billion to AI safety and evaluation
WBPDCL initiates surplus coal sales to NTPC to boost power supply
summary: Indian indices face a sixth weekly decline as IT and Tata stocks drag the Sensex lower despite Nifty's marginal gains. Global factors like US Fed policy and oil prices remain key triggers while AI investments by Accenture and Anthropic signal sector growth. Retail sentiment is tested by UPI MDR concerns in Ghaziabad and the ongoing shift toward cash transactions.
